Q201.why: Ideal-diode FET, source on VBAT_IN beside J910 so the 60 A path from the terminal is short; tab VBAT_D (LM74910H 9.5.1: A, DGATE, C close to source, gate, drain). Unchanged.

Q202.why: Second ideal-diode FET in parallel with Q201; same reasons. Its tab sits under the GND bar, allowed with tented vias (D01: 199 via sites, 30 needed). Unchanged.

Q203.why: Load-disconnect FET, drain VBAT_Q2D from the shunt, source VBAT_PROT to the In4 plane (LM74910H 9.5.1: HGATE and OUT close to gate and source). Unchanged.

Q204.why: Second load-disconnect FET in parallel with Q203. Unchanged.

U202.why: INA228 moved from (187.2, 90.6) to beside the shunt: IN+ 8.7 mm and IN- 7.2 mm from R201's pads (was 68 mm). INA228-Q1 10.1: Kelvin (4-wire) connection to the sense resistor; any high-current impedance between the pins is measurement error.

C214.why: U202's 100 nF supply bypass, moved from F.Cu (68 mm away) to B.Cu beside pin 6 (VS), 2.7 mm pad to pin. INA228-Q1 10.1: bypass as close as possible to the supply and ground pins. The top above U202 is under the GND bar, so it can't stay on top.

U201.why: LM74910H stays between the two FET pairs: DGATE reaches Q201/Q202's gates in 6 to 9 mm; CS+ and CS- sense R201 through R209/C212 (LM74910H 9.5.1: Kelvin connection for CS+ and CS-). Unchanged.

R209.why: CS+ filter resistor, 1.5 mm from U201's CSP pin; the Kelvin trace runs from R201. Unchanged.

C212.why: CS filter capacitor at U201's CSP pin. Unchanged.

C213.why: ISCP filter capacitor; slow, may move 2 mm.

R202.why: HGATE series resistor to Q203/Q204's gates. Unchanged.

C209.why: Charge-pump capacitor (CAP to VS), 4.5 mm from U201, kept off the FET bodies (LM74910H 9.5.1: keep it away from the MOSFET to lower thermal effects on its value). Unchanged.
